title: actions: a standalone action item authored at runtime through the metadata door (with objectName) is saved but renders on no surface of its object
body:
domain:devx#2 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYmTYfaPbLQD4BJfomW

Filing gate: ① a product defect observed by a named producer: QA run #27441 (18.3.0 RC, `c4c515ad`), item `studio-authoring.access-facets-runtime` requires[2] / steps[1]. The wave-3 accuracy slice S2 report (#27377 comment 6539872216, PR #28351) classed it a product defect, class c, not a checklist error. ⛔ Not a claim; triage grades and routes. Suggested labels are suggestions only.

## Observed
- A standalone `action` metadata item carrying `objectName`, authored at runtime through the metadata door, saves successfully but appears on no surface of its target object.
- **Not re-measured by the slice or the seat.**

## Mechanism (code reading by the slice dev)
- `packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts` documents that the engine attaches a standalone action item to its target through `SchemaRegistry` `attachBoundActions` when the target is served (~L5328).
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useConsoleActionRuntime.tsx` reads `objectDef.actions`. Its own comment says "a standalone action row no object embeds is absent from it".
- **Seam:** spec `ActionSchema.objectName` → runtime `SchemaRegistry.attachBoundActions` → renderer `useConsoleActionRuntime` objectActions. Either the runtime attach does not run for a runtime-authored item, or the console reads a list that never receives it.

## Why it matters
- **Who:** a Studio or API author adding an action to an object at runtime.
- **What happens:** the save succeeds, yet the action is nowhere to be found. The capability is declared but not honoured, and it fails silently.

## Dedupe
- Search terms: `standalone action item`, `runtime-authored action`, `attachBoundActions`, `objectName action renders nowhere`.
